description: This file contains test cases for training various image classification models using the ImageAI library. It sets up datasets, models, and runs training procedures for ResNet50, DenseNet121, InceptionV3, and MobileNetV2 architectures, verifying the creation of model files and configuration JSONs.

methods.name: test_resnet50_training
methods.description: Tests training of ResNet50 model with optional transfer learning.

methods.description: Tests training of DenseNet121 model with optional transfer learning.
